reviewer: Codex, unblinded source review against saved inputs; not independent human adjudication
rubric: Usable: supported central reading and useful role fulfillment, tolerating awkward wording. Minor edit: central reading supported but a small factual/wording correction is needed. Material error: misleading meaning, subject, status, measurement or relationship. Contract errors and unavailable cases are separate. These purposive development samples do not estimate routine population accuracy.
